scope: Autenticação e autorização HTTP em HTTPS/loopback com PostgreSQL sintético. M1 ainda incompleto; não comprova recuperação, convite, idempotência por chave, UI ou piloto.

source_records.role: Fonte da revalidação de sessão, vínculo e permissões; recorte registrado no M0.
Identity com confirmação de e-mail, senha, lockout e cookies.
Antiforgery e limitação de tentativas, adaptados à composição própria.

adaptations: Fluxo Identity preserva senha/MFA, lockout cinco tentativas/15 minutos, confirmação de e-mail e sessão absoluta de oito horas; callbacks e sessão persistida pertencem ao Wissian.
Cookies __Host-Wissian, DataProtection purpose Wissian, CSRF e keyring próprios; nenhuma credencial, claim de tenant autoritativa ou janela de administrador herdada.
Revalidação servidor usa as políticas Core de S1 e o escopo RLS de S2. Catálogo confiável, vínculo/versão, organização ativa, disponibilidade, ativação e permissão são conferidos a cada leitura.
Falhas anônimas usam log com correlação sem credencial/identificador submetido. Transições identificadas têm auditoria persistida.
Unknown-user password check usa um hash descartável por processo em vez de calcular hash novo por tentativa.
added_for_proven_gap: Gate antes do tráfego: papel runtime sem ownership/bypass/migrador e lista exata de migrations aplicadas; host nunca aplica migrations. Migration aditiva RuntimeSchemaRead concede somente SELECT no histórico.
API de seleção tem versão esperada, valida organização/vínculo no servidor e expõe conflito 409 sem efeito duplicado em concorrência. Recibo idempotente por chave permanece pendente.
Desafio MFA guarda security stamp no ticket protegido e o confere a cada uso. Transições rastreadas reais de IsActive rotacionam stamps; reativação não ressuscita tickets.
HTTPS real no laboratório, confiança restrita ao certificado sintético exato, chaves DPAPI testadas após reinício. Nenhuma autoridade certificadora ou certificado foi instalado como confiável.

environment.data: Synthetic only; separate random migrator/runtime credentials; fresh loopback cluster.
environment.server_shutdown: Verified exit 0, server stopped, postmaster.pid absent after final 26-case run.
environment.dependencies: Same EF/Identity/Npgsql versions as S2; no new external package version or product service.

cases.oracle: Unauthenticated API and cleartext transport denied
CSRF, own secure cookies and token rotation after login
Two organizations, context resolved on server, foreign/nonexistent denial equivalent
Platform label without membership grants no authority
Permission revocation on next HTTP call
Disabled module removes capability and denies direct URL
Revoked membership removes context
Revoked session rejects original/copied ticket
Observed inactive user revokes session
Security stamp invalidates cookie immediately
Logout requires CSRF and invalidates copied cookie
Absolute eight-hour expiry, no sliding renewal
MFA requires current challenge and valid authenticator; retry after wrong code succeeds
Lockout after five failures and generic inactive/unconfirmed/unknown rejection
Owner/migrator credential rejected before traffic
Mandatory runtime configuration
Real limiter rejects ninth authentication attempt per IP/minute
Concurrent context selection yields 200/409 and one audit effect
Unexpected JSON properties and crossed membership pairing rejected
Old schema rejected without host migration
DPAPI-protected persisted keyring survives restart; distinct keys reject ticket
Suspended organization removes context and access
Tampered ticket and request larger than 32 KiB rejected
Credential revocation invalidates pending MFA
MFA challenge expires after five minutes
Suspend/reactivate without intervening request cannot revive session or MFA

persistence_regression.note: New/repeated/failing/recovered/upgrade migration paths include RuntimeSchemaRead. Final added user-activation stamp invariant is covered by API cases 09/13/24/26.

verification.build: API project and affected dependencies built with warnings-as-errors; no warnings/errors

review.method: Focused review of authentication, cookie/CSRF, scoped authority, schema privileges and negative HTTP tests.
resolved: Windows SChannel rejected ephemeral CNG keys before reaching API. Synthetic certificate imported to a temporary default key container, disposed after the suite; no TLS checks disabled in runtime.
Review found pending MFA must be invalidated by changed credentials; stamp-bound challenge added and verified in case24.

New activation guard initially treated Identity's mark-all-fields update as a real activation transition, invalidating a challenge after one incorrect code. Case13 failed (25/26); comparison with tracked original value fixed the cause. Final 26/26 passed.
Reactivation without intermediate request must not revive old tickets; tracked activation transitions rotate security/concurrency stamps and case26 passed.
review.residual: Identity lifecycle commands must load the current user and use tracked changes/Identity APIs; detached/bulk/direct SQL changes are not a supported activation path. Commands of future modules must keep current authority and effect in one transaction.
